name: Mawaru Sekai to Mahoutsukai ~First chapter : snowflakes falling all around~
original_name: 廻る世界と魔法使い ～First chapter : snowflakes falling all around～
source:
The main character, Goki Osaki, was living an ordinary life.
He woke up every morning by my his friend Ayato Tsukishima,
Attention to the chairman Ueno Ren,
Don't get involved with the lone wolf Kokushi Washi,
Laughing with junior Komagome Yuki,
He yearns for the school idol, Momoka Tabata.

[Taken from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/8400]Freem![/url]]
translation:
主人公大崎五贵过着平凡的生活。
每天早上他都会被我的朋友月岛绫人叫醒，
董事长上野仁请注意，
别跟独狼国志和纸扯上关系，
和小込由纪一起笑，
他向往学园偶像田端桃花。
